summary: Confirmed the empty estimates array after reading the entire markdown conversion through the references and checking the cited PDF pages with pymupdf, including recovery of Tables 1-4. The 15-page paper contains no appendix. Study counts match the abstract and Table 2: 900 randomized and 659 analyzed; Autonomous 278/222, Dependent 294/225, and No-AI 328/212 randomized/analyzed. All reported randomized-arm contrasts for originality and within-essay idea diversity in both phases adjust for same-phase time on task (PDF p. 6, Section 2.8; pp. 7-8, Sections 3.2-3.4 and Figure 2). Table 1 explicitly identifies those times as post-treatment (PDF p. 4), so extraction rule 5 excludes these contrasts and the additional time-adjusted sensitivity result (PDF p. 9). Idea diversity measures within-person flexibility, not diversity across people. Reasoning quality measures argumentative-writing proficiency (PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 2.3 and 2.6); rule 6 excludes its main results, sensitivity analyses, and baseline-to-transfer change means (PDF p. 12, Section 4.5). Self-reports, workflow checks, trait associations, and mediation analyses are also appropriately excluded. No eligible unadjusted creativity outcome or omitted full-sample contrast was found. Checked is zero because there are no estimate records.
